A1.justification: Both PDFs present the same UniMLVG research, with 25 pages, supplementary Sections 6–9, Tables 1–5, and Figures 1–20. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison support reliable assessment, including the image-heavy appendices.

before.justification: v1 reports original UniMLVG evaluation results on nuScenes, ablations in Tables 2–5, and qualitative video-generation, weather-editing, and simulation-conditioned results, including supplementary examples.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark results, ablations, and qualitative generation examples from v1, including those in the supplement.

M1.justification: The architecture, rectified-flow objectives, four training tasks, conditioning mechanisms, perspective modeling, and three-stage training procedure are unchanged, including the supplementary implementation of camera rays and feature fusion.

E1.justification: Both use OpenDV-Youtube, nuScenes, Waymo, and Argoverse2. Reference-conditioned and reference-free generation, weather editing, and CARLA-conditioned examples retain the same coverage throughout the main text and supplement.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains Oracle, DriveGAN, DriveDreamer, MagicDrive, Drive-WM, DriveDreamer-2, DreamForge, and DiVE. The comparison configurations within the ablations also remain unchanged.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 retains the same dataset splits, metrics, training settings, and inference settings. Evaluation still uses 150 nuScenes scenes, six viewpoints and 16 frames per viewpoint, with 900 videos for FVD and 10,000 sampled images for FID.

E4.justification: The condition/camera, dataset, training-stage, and task-ratio ablations in Tables 2–5 are identical. Figure 7's long-generation comparison and the diversity, consistency, weather-editing, and simulation case studies are also retained unchanged.

E5.justification: Both retain the same point-estimate reporting in Tables 1–5. Neither introduces repeated-run counts, seeds, error bars, confidence intervals, or significance tests; supplementary reporting is also unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical entries and rankings in Tables 1–5 are identical, including UniMLVG's FID 8.8 and FVD 60.1 in Table 1. Qualitative samples and supplementary dataset-description statistics are unchanged.

T1.justification: The training-loss equations, ray-coordinate encoding, camera-ray construction, and feature-fusion formulation in Sections 3, 6, and 7 are identical. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions concerning controllable multi-view long-video generation, multi-task/multi-stage training, diverse datasets, and explicit perspective modeling. The reported 21.4% FID and 36.5% FVD improvement claims are unchanged.

C2.justification: Explanations of reference-frame reliance, explicit camera modeling, task specialization, and weather-editing generalization remain unchanged. No substantive limitations or applicability qualifications are added or removed.

D1.justification: The front-page 'Demo & Code & Checkpoints' project-site link is replaced by a 'Code' link to the SenseTime-FVG/OpenDWM repository. This changes documented access information; the PDFs do not establish whether actual demo or checkpoint availability changed. Other technical details are identical.

R1.justification: The same 65 references and related-work discussions are retained, including positioning relative to MagicDrive, Drive-WM, DiVE, and DriveDreamer-2. No novelty relationship or research positioning changes.

P1.justification: Author footnote symbols are swapped consistently while preserving the attributed roles. The front-page resource label and arXiv version/date stamp change, but scientific prose, section organization, and supplementary structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The front-page resource line is reformatted, and spacing below Figure 3 on page 4 changes slightly, shifting the following text and equation upward. All figures, tables, captions, and appendix layouts otherwise remain identical.

improvement.justification: The methods, experimental evidence, explanations, and full supplement are unchanged. The revised code pointer, footnote symbols, and small spacing adjustments show no meaningful overall quality gain or loss; the PDFs alone do not establish improved or reduced resource availability.
